title: PowerFly HZEB-LCT-20 20.992kWh Ground-Mounted Battery
summary: A 20kWh-class 51.2V LiFePO4 battery for larger homes and small commercial backup applications.

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: >=6,000 cycles at cabinet level; up to 8,000 at cell level

faqs.question: Is 20 kWh enough for a whole home?
faqs.answer: Essential circuits run 24-48 hours; full home use including AC runs 12-24 hours, depending on daily consumption.

faqs.question: How is it installed?
faqs.answer: As a ground-mounted cabinet on a level floor. IP21 means indoor or sheltered space only, not an exposed wall.

faqs.question: Can I connect multiple units?
faqs.answer: Yes, parallel connection is supported. Confirm the final bank size with us, because cabinet count and cable sizing are project-specific.
